# harness_chaos_scan (Resource)

Resource for creating a Harness Chaos scan.

A scan is one object. Set `pipeline_scan` to scan a successful pipeline execution, which is the execution the UI lists. Set `infrastructure_scan` with `infrastructure_id` and `environment_id` from `harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2` to scan that Kubernetes infrastructure. Terraform reads the linked discovery agent and sends the same agent, environment, and parent id as the UI Scan infrastructure action. `agent_identity` and `environment_identity` remain supported when the discovery agent is already known, including imports. It is not a Harness service. Collection fails when a pipeline execution has no Kubernetes CD stage, or when the infrastructure has no discovery agent.

Create waits until the scan is COMPLETED, ERRORED, or ABORTED. ERRORED and ABORTED fail the apply and include `error_message` when the API recorded one. COMPLETED can still have an empty `risks` list when analysis found nothing. The default create timeout is 30 minutes.

Set `detection_method` to `ai` for the UI AI Scan, or `ruleBased` for the UI Rule-based Scan. `AI` and `RiskAnalyzer` are accepted as the same choices. Leave it unset and the API uses AI Scan.

The first apply creates one scan. Later applies of the same resource do not create another scan on the UI. Terraform does not watch the cluster. To run that same scan again after this configuration creates or updates the chaos infrastructure, set `retry_token` to `harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2.<name>.updated_at`. The identifier stays the same, so the UI still shows one scan and the results are refreshed. Change `identity` only when you want a different scan. That deletes the current scan and creates the new one.

Only `name`, `description`, and `tags` can be updated in place. Changing identity, organization, project, detection method, pipeline identity, pipeline execution, chaos infrastructure, agent identity, or environment identity replaces the scan. Values the API writes back (`infrastructures`, `notify_id`, `agent_identity` when it was resolved, `environment_parent_unique_id`) do not replace it.

`risks` is a computed view of this scan's report, sorted by identity. It is not the durable scanned risk. A report read failure keeps the previous `risks` value. Change `retry_token` to retry. Change `abort_token` on an existing scan to abort it; `ABORTED` then succeeds. Create holds the state lock, so another apply cannot abort a create that is still waiting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Scan a pipeline execution. This is the same scan the UI starts after you
# pick a pipeline and a successful execution.
resource "harness_chaos_scan" "pipeline" {
  org_id     = "default"
  project_id = "demo"
  identity   = "cart_deploy_scan"
  name       = "Cart deploy scan"

  # UI dropdown: "ai" is AI Scan, "ruleBased" is Rule-based Scan.
  # "AI" and "RiskAnalyzer" are accepted as the same choices.
  # Omit detection_method to let the API use AI Scan.
  detection_method = "ruleBased"

  pipeline_scan {
    pipeline_identity     = "cart_deploy"
    pipeline_execution_id = "exec-123"
  }
}

# Scan a Kubernetes infrastructure. infrastructure_id and environment_id are
# the chaos infrastructure, the same values as harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2.
# Terraform reads the linked discovery agent and sends the same source the UI
# sends for Scan infrastructure.
resource "harness_chaos_scan" "infrastructure" {
  org_id     = "default"
  project_id = "demo"
  identity   = "payments_infra_scan"
  name       = "Payments infrastructure scan"

  # AI Scan. Use "ruleBased" for a Rule-based Scan.
  detection_method = "ai"

  infrastructure_scan {
    infrastructure_id = harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2.payments.infra_id
    environment_id    = harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2.payments.environment_id
  }

  # Refreshes this same scan when the Terraform infrastructure is created or
  # updated. An apply that leaves updated_at unchanged does not scan again.
  retry_token = harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2.payments.updated_at
}

# The discovery agent can still be set directly. Imports use this form because
# the API stores the agent, not the chaos infrastructure id.
resource "harness_chaos_scan" "infrastructure_by_agent" {
  org_id     = "default"
  project_id = "demo"
  identity   = "payments_agent_scan"
  name       = "Payments agent scan"

  infrastructure_scan {
    agent_identity       = "payments-agent"
    environment_identity = "prod"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Unique identifier of this scan. This becomes the resource id. The API rejects an identifier that already exists. Another apply keeps this identifier and does not create a second scan. Change `retry_token` to run this same scan again after the infrastructure changes. Change `identity` only to replace this scan with a different one; Terraform then deletes the current scan.
- `name` (String) Name of the scan.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Scans are project scoped, matching the UI. The agent that runs the scan is called with the account, organization, and project.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier. Scans are project scoped, matching the UI. A scan created outside a project does not appear on the project Risks pages.

### Optional

- `abort_token` (String) Change this on an existing scan to abort it, using the same API as the UI. `ABORTED` is a successful apply. Create holds the state lock, so this cannot abort a create that is still running. Do not change this and `retry_token` in the same apply.
- `description` (String) Description of the scan.
- `detection_method` (String) Scan method, matching the UI dropdown. `ai` is AI Scan. `ruleBased` is Rule-based Scan. `AI` and `RiskAnalyzer` are the same choices and remain accepted. Leave this unset to let the API choose AI Scan. Changing between AI Scan and Rule-based Scan creates a new scan. Another apply that keeps the same method does not.
- `infrastructure_scan` (Block List, Max: 1) Infrastructure scan. Scans the Kubernetes infrastructure known to a discovery agent and records scan type DiscoveryAgent. Set `infrastructure_id` and `environment_id` from the chaos infrastructure, or set `agent_identity` and `environment_identity` when the discovery agent is already known. Exactly one of `pipeline_scan` or `infrastructure_scan` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--infrastructure_scan))
- `pipeline_scan` (Block List, Max: 1) Pipeline scan. Scans one pipeline execution and records scan type PipelineExecution. Exactly one of `pipeline_scan` or `infrastructure_scan` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pipeline_scan))
- `retry_token` (String) Change this to a new value to run this scan again, using the same API as the UI retry action. The scan identifier stays the same, so this does not add another scan on the UI. Set it to `harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2.<name>.updated_at` to run again only when that Terraform infrastructure is created or updated. An apply that leaves this value unchanged does not scan again. Terraform waits until the scan is COMPLETED, ERRORED, or ABORTED. ERRORED and ABORTED fail the apply.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the scan.
- `timeouts` (Block) Override the 30 minute create and update wait. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account identifier.
- `collected_data` (List of Object) Resources collected before analysis. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collected_data))
- `completed_at` (Number) Completion time as a Unix timestamp. Empty until the scan finishes.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) User who created the scan.
- `error_message` (String) Error recorded when the scan fails.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `result` (String) Outcome of a completed scan, such as SUCCESS or NO_RESOURCES_FOUND.
- `retry_count` (Number) Number of times the scan has been retried.
- `risk_summary` (List of Object) Analysis summary written when the scan finishes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risk_summary))
- `risks` (List of Object) Computed view of the risks embedded in this scan's report, sorted by identity. Empty until analysis finishes, including a COMPLETED scan that found nothing. This is not the durable scanned risk. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risks))
- `scan_type` (String) Scan type recorded by the API. `PipelineExecution` for a pipeline scan, `DiscoveryAgent` for an infrastructure scan.
- `status` (String) Scan lifecycle status: QUEUED, COLLECTING, COLLECTED, ANALYSING, COMPLETED, ERRORED, or ABORTED. Risks are populated once the scan completes.
- `summary` (List of Object) Severity rollup for the scan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary))
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update time as a Unix timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) User who last updated the scan.

<a id="nestedblock--infrastructure_scan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `infrastructure_scan`

Optional:

- `agent_identity` (String) Identity of the service discovery agent that observed the Kubernetes infrastructure. Set this when the agent is already known, including imports. Leave it unset when `infrastructure_id` is set; Terraform fills it from the linked agent.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment of the chaos infrastructure. Same value as `harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2.environment_id`. Required with `infrastructure_id`.
- `environment_identity` (String) Environment identifier of the discovery agent. Required with `agent_identity`. When `infrastructure_id` is set, Terraform fills this from the agent record, matching the UI.
- `environment_parent_unique_id` (String) Parent unique id of the discovery agent's environment. The UI sends this from the agent record. Terraform fills it when `infrastructure_id` is set.
- `infrastructure_id` (String) Identifier of the chaos infrastructure to scan. Same value as `harness_chaos_infrastructure_v2.infra_id`. Terraform reads the discovery agent linked to this infrastructure, which is what the UI selects for Scan infrastructure.

<a id="nestedblock--pipeline_scan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pipeline_scan`

Required:

- `pipeline_execution_id` (String) Execution id (`planExecutionId`) of a pipeline run whose status is Success. The UI only offers those executions. Collection fails when the execution has no Kubernetes CD stage.
- `pipeline_identity` (String) Identifier of the pipeline to scan.

Optional:

- `notify_id` (String) Notification id used when a pipeline step triggers the scan. Omit this for scans created the same way as the UI.

Read-Only:

- `infrastructures` (List of Object) CD environment and infrastructure pairs observed while collecting manifests. Populated by the scan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pipeline_scan--infrastructures))

<a id="nestedatt--pipeline_scan--infrastructures"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pipeline_scan.infrastructures`

Read-Only:

- `chaos_onboarded` (Boolean) Whether chaos is already onboarded for this infrastructure.
- `chaos_supported` (Boolean) Whether this infrastructure can be onboarded to chaos.
- `environment_ref` (String) Environment reference.
- `infrastructure_identity` (String) Infrastructure identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--risks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `risks`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the risk.
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint that groups occurrences of the same risk.
- `identity` (String) Identity of the scanned risk. Stable across scans that find the same risk.
- `metadata_json` (String) Additional risk metadata as a JSON object string.
- `name` (String) Name of the risk.
- `occurrences` (List of Object) Detections of this risk in the scan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--risks--occurrences))
- `service_identity` (String) Identity of the service the risk applies to.
- `service_name` (String) Name of the service the risk applies to.
- `service_type` (String) Service kind, such as DiscoveredService, ChaosService, or CDService.
- `severity` (String) Severity: Critical, High, Medium, or Low.
- `status` (String) Status: Open, InProgress, Resolved, or Ignored.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags on the risk.

<a id="nestedatt--risks--occurrences"></a>
### Nested Schema for `risks.occurrences`

Read-Only:

- `detected_at` (Number) Detection time as a Unix timestamp.
- `evidence` (List of String) Evidence for the occurrence.
- `occurrence_id` (String) Identity of this occurrence.
- `remediation` (List of String) Remediation guidance.
- `resilience_testing_rec` (List of String) Resilience testing recommendations.
- `service_name` (String) Service name recorded on the occurrence.
- `source_id` (String) Source id of the occurrence. For a scan this is the scan identity.
- `source_type` (String) Source type of the occurrence.

<a id="nestedatt--collected_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collected_data`

Read-Only:

- `errors` (List of Object) Collection failures returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collected_data--errors))

<a id="nestedatt--collected_data--errors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collected_data.errors`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String) Collection error message.
- `source` (String) Collector that reported the error.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Project scope. org_id and project_id are required.
terraform import harness_chaos_scan.example <org_id>/<project_id>/<scan_identity>
```
